observation.visible_scene: A close, slightly high-angle view of a black gas stovetop with four cast-iron burner grates set on a speckled granite countertop. A black-gloved hand holds a steam-cleaner nozzle that emits a visible white steam/vapor jet onto the right-side burners and surrounding surface. From roughly the middle of the clip onward, a pale-green steam-cleaner tank with a black hose and handle becomes visible resting on the counter at the right edge.
visible_changes: The gloved nozzle continuously sprays a plume of white steam, sweeping across the right front and right rear burner areas and the back edge of the stovetop.
The nozzle and hand translate around the right half of the cooktop, shifting the steam jet's target between the grates, burner caps, and the flat surface.
The steam plume expands and drifts leftward over the center of the stovetop as it is emitted, partially obscuring the middle burners.
The camera view gradually widens and pans/tilts slightly toward the right, revealing more of the granite counter and the green steam-cleaner unit that was out of frame initially.
The burner grates remain seated in place throughout; no grate is lifted or removed within the excerpt.
The stovetop surface appears dark and wet/reflective, consistent with ongoing steam contact.
outside_clip_unknowns: When the steam-cleaning session began and whether the left-side burners were cleaned before this segment.
Whether the grates were ever removed for cleaning (none are seen lifted here).
The final cleanliness or drying outcome after the clip ends.
The identity and other actions of the person operating the steam cleaner.
uncertain_details: It is hard to separate small camera drift from the hand's nozzle motion because both change the framing together.
The exact moment the green steam unit enters view is gradual due to camera movement rather than object movement.
Whether the visible white haze is solely steam from the nozzle or also includes vapor rising from the heated/wet surface is not directly distinguishable.
